meta.title: NYC Weekly Rundown
meta.audience: Budget-conscious recent grad living in NYC

flexible.title: Chess pickup at Washington Square Park
flexible.description: Casual pickup chess at the park's SW chess tables — challenge a hustler for cash or just play a friend.
flexible.priceNote: Free (cash games if you play the hustlers)
flexible.location: Greenwich Village — Washington Square Park, SW chess tables

flexible.title: CityPickle pickleball drop-in
flexible.description: Drop-in pickleball on 14 courts with paddle rentals, all skill levels welcome.
flexible.prereqs: Walk-up or reserve online; all skill levels

flexible.title: Staten Island Ferry
flexible.description: Free 25-minute ride past the Statue of Liberty and lower Manhattan skyline — the best free view in the city.

events.title: Met Summer HD Festival: free opera screenings
events.description: Free outdoor opera screenings (Wagner, Bellini, Tchaikovsky, Puccini) on the plaza.
events.prereqs: No RSVP, ~2,500 first-come seats — arrive early

events.title: Smorgasburg Central Park
events.description: 25+ food vendors at Columbus Circle, free entry with pay-per-item food.

events.title: Pickleball pickup (all levels)
events.description: Drop-in pickup pickleball via Volo Sports.
events.prereqs: RSVP via Volo app — spots very limited

events.title: Coed softball drop-in (10v10)
events.description: Drop-in coed softball via Volo Sports.
events.prereqs: RSVP via Volo app — spots very limited

events.title: NYC Unicycle Festival, Day 1
events.description: Long-distance group ride from Battery Park to Central Park, open to riders and spectators.

events.title: Soft Strides Anniversary Run Club
events.description: Community run followed by a small celebration with DJ, doughnuts, and B-12 shots.

events.title: Free Brass Festival
events.description: Grammy-nominated New Breed Brass Band and other brass acts; blankets provided.

events.title: Coney Island Friday Night Fireworks
events.description: Free fireworks viewable from the boardwalk — likely the last Friday of the season.
events.location: Boardwalk btwn W 10th–15th St, Coney Island, Brooklyn

events.title: NYC Unicycle Festival, Day 2
events.description: Group ride from Brooklyn Bridge to Coney Island, open to riders and onlookers.

events.title: Immigrant Jam comedy showcase
events.description: Stand-up comedy from immigrant and first-gen comedians. The one paid 'special occasion' pick this week.
events.location: Caveat, 21A Clinton St, Lower East Side

events.title: Sephora St. Marks Celebration
events.description: Scratch-off cards for prizes, including gift cards totaling $2,000.
events.prereqs: No RSVP; expect a line on weekend afternoons

events.title: The Woobles Pop-Up Shop
events.description: First 300 visitors per day get a free crochet kit; free friendship-bracelet station.

events.title: KIKO Milano SoHo Grand Opening
events.description: First 500 guests get complimentary products; free makeup application/engraving.

events.title: Smorgasburg: Pull Up a Plate
events.description: Community party with live bands/DJs and 'Smorgin' on a Budget' $9 specials.

events.title: Richmond County Fair (46th annual)
events.description: Old-timey fair with bingo, races, stilt walkers, and fair food. A genuinely different NYC day trip.
events.prereqs: Ferry + short bus/car ride to venue

events.title: NYC Unicycle Festival, weekend leg
events.description: Includes games and a learn-to-ride area — good one to actually try it, not just watch.

events.title: Jewish Museum — free Saturdays
events.description: Free general admission every Saturday.

events.title: Bar trivia (check day-of listings)
events.description: No single confirmed lineup for this date — check NYC Trivia League or NYCTriviaList.com day-of for a bar near you.
events.priceNote: Usually free to play, drink minimum

events.title: Lavazza Tablì Coffee Pop-Up
events.description: Complimentary espresso + pastries, showcasing a new espresso system.

events.title: The Serve, presented by SharkNinja
events.description: Interactive brand activation with styling, skincare, and complimentary drinks.

events.title: Islands in the Park: Caribbean Jam
events.description: Caribbean food, music, steel pan, and arts & crafts — a warm-up to the West Indian Day Parade.

events.title: Between Tides (ping-pong art installation)
events.description: Interactive ping-pong table art installation on the boardwalk; free paddles/balls provided.

events.title: NYC Unicycle Festival, final day
events.description: Last chance to try the learn-to-ride area.

events.title: Studio Museum in Harlem — free every Sunday
events.description: Free general admission every Sunday.

events.title: Richmond County Fair, Day 2
events.description: See Saturday listing for details.
events.prereqs: Ferry + short bus/car ride to venue

events.title: Lavazza, The Serve, Sephora, Woobles, KIKO — last day
events.description: All the weekend pop-ups/free-food activations wrap today — last chance if you haven't gone.

events.title: West Indian Day Parade & Carnival
events.description: One of the largest cultural parades in the US (~2 million attendees) — steel-pan bands, elaborate costumes, incredible Caribbean food along the route. Expect heavy crowds; go early for a good spot.
events.location: Eastern Parkway, Crown Heights → Grand Army Plaza, Brooklyn
events.prereqs: Full-day, all-ages, but very packed by afternoon

events.title: Bryant Park Movie Night: Galaxy Quest
events.description: Free outdoor screening. Bring a blanket, first-come-first-served.
events.prereqs: No RSVP — arrive by 6–6:30pm for a good lawn spot

events.title: Richmond County Fair, final day
events.description: See Saturday listing for details.
events.prereqs: Ferry + short bus/car ride to venue

events.title: Guggenheim — pay-what-you-wish
events.description: Walk-in, pay-what-you-wish admission — a legit way to see a major collection cheap.

events.title: Frick Collection — pay-what-you-wish
events.description: Walk-in, pay-what-you-wish admission.

events.title: New York Botanical Garden — free morning hour
events.description: Free 10–11am general admission (free all day for NYC residents). Worth a full garden day.
events.priceNote: Free 10–11am; free all day for NYC residents
events.prereqs: NYC residents should bring proof of residency for all-day free entry
